title: The City of London's Remembrancer sits in Parliament

tellings.quote: they've also got the only unelected members who can go into parliament called the remembrancer.

plain: The City of London, the old financial district that runs its own local government, is said to have an official called the Remembrancer, the only unelected person allowed to sit in Parliament. The UFO researcher Jay Anderson brings this up from the documentary The Spider's Web: Britain's Second Empire, as a sign of how much quiet power the City holds over the British state.
